description: Synthetic: Claude in a plain ~/src/acme folder (no git origin) after opening acme/shop#817, whose github.com URL is on screen. The prose names bare #812-#816, and the status line links to another repo (acme/ops-tools). The PR written with its repo is the only one that may be reported (the model can fairly leave it out of working_prs); no bare number gets a repo guessed from the folder (acme/acme) or from that link.
